package probe

import "os/exec"

// These are the values the e2e tier's sites assign: a composite literal, even
// empty, and a make call, which are both non-nil.
func envAcceptedForms(env []string) []error {
	literal := exec.Command("one")
	literal.Env = []string{}

	made := exec.Command("two")
	made.Env = make([]string, 0, len(env))

	appended := exec.Command("three")
	appended.Env = append([]string{}, env...)

	return []error{literal.Run(), made.Run(), appended.Run()}
}
